scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Publish the fixed-bulk egg contact-integration axis and its complete zero-level qualification.

zero_level_complete_state_and_field_qual.scope: Compare all saved paired-reference arrays and full stress fields without a new solve.
zero_level_complete_state_and_field_qual.limitations: Complete saved histories are compared at identical physical inputs and byte-identical geometry. By default initializer bytes must match; the explicit resolved-initializer option instead checks every initializer array at the original state budget and retains its measured difference. Independent force-audit results are checked and retained, not reassembled in this field comparison. This proves numerical equivalence only for these saved states; it establishes neither physical convergence nor a controlled timing improvement or warmed production cost.

fixed_bulk_contact_integration_compariso.scope: Separate contact-integration changes on byte-identical egg bulk geometry and mass.
fixed_bulk_contact_integration_compariso.limitations: Only the body collision trace sampling changes, with exact P2 interpolation onto unchanged bulk unknowns. Reference geometry/initializer anchors are byte-identical, and original physical material/mass, finger meshes/axes/masses, controls, dt, friction and barrier range remain fixed. Each case independently resolves its original held initializer. Undeformed actual surface areas are checked by group; deformed surface and active lumped support can change. Opposite finger reactions identify source wrenches, not continuum contact islands. Force-density norms use discrete nodal forces divided by positive lumped sample areas, not a continuous pressure reconstruction. Normal-contact rotation invariance is checked separately; total frictional surface moment is measured without imposing an additional zero-moment acceptance gate on the existing finite-gap, lagged-tangent friction law. One final common-time comparison isolates this contact-integration axis conditionally on the fixed bulk/geometry and regularization; it does not establish bulk/geometry convergence, full histories/application, model/feedback accuracy or verified warmed cost.

limitations: All15 new states and their independent original-force audits are preserved on one identical1920-tet material geometry and mass. Only body P2 contact trace integration changes; fingers stay fixed. The zero case preserves all original saved arrays and complete corner/quadrature fields under existing budgets after independently repeating the same held controls. Its initializer is numerically compared, not falsely labeled byte-identical. Final tensor/energy changes near1% remain conditional on fixed bulk/geometry, finger discretization and contact regularization. Four active samples and shrinking lumped area do not establish a physical pressure/area tail. Lumped force-density norms are discrete diagnostics; total frictional surface moment is retained without adding a zero-moment gate to the original law. Full physical/contact/geometry/thickness/history/model/feedback and physically verified warmed-cost requirements remain open. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
